title: Behind the Screen
blurb: Shadow puppets, one puppet master. Four questions.
fact: The dalang does it all: moves every puppet, voices every character, leads the singers and conducts the gamelan, while keeping sound effects with a mallet and his foot.
credit: Facts from the National Heritage Board's Roots entry on wayang kulit. Text and art are original.

questions.prompt: Who controls the puppets in wayang kulit?
questions.note: The dalang, the puppet master, also voices the characters and conducts the orchestra.

questions.prompt: What holds the puppets upright while they wait?
questions.note: Their pointed ends are staked into a banana trunk, with good characters on the dalang's left and bad on his right.

questions.prompt: Some people sit behind the screen instead of in front. What is that seat linked to?
questions.note: From behind you see the puppets themselves, a position traditionally associated with the gods.

questions.prompt: Which local hero appears in wayang kulit in Singapore?
questions.note: Local versions feature figures like Sang Nila Utama, Hang Nadim and Hang Tuah, alongside the Ramayana and Mahabharata.
